profile.headline: SWE @ Microsoft
profile.summary:
Focused on the overlap of technology and playful design with an emphasis on education and science communication.

https://odessathompson.github.io/

positions.title: Design and Operations Subteam Member
positions.description: Collaborates with a team of software and hardware engineers to design and build an autonomous aircraft for the international AUVSI SUAS Competition.

positions.title: Education and Community Programs Intern
positions.description:
- Illustrated and wrote a Pre-K children's shapes book distributed to each preschooler in the Ithaca City School District. 
- Write, edit, and animate monthly STEM curriculum videos for elementary schools

company.name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art

positions.title: Digital Product Design TA
positions.description: After taking the class, I became a TA the following semester to support other students in their design journeys. I led critique sessions and office hours with my section in order to help them develop their products and designs for their users.

positions.title: Beaverworks Summer Insititute at MIT
positions.description:
- Studied data science in connection with health and medicine.
- Developed a machine learning model that predicted opioid dependence using marijuana use and multi-layer perceptron classifiers.

honors.title: Intel International Science and Technology Fair Finalist
honors.description: Competed as an Environmental Engineering Finalist in Pittsburgh and presented a biodegradable algae bioplastic as an alternative to single-use plastics
honors.issuer: Issued by International Science and Technology Fair · May 2018
